responsibility: Declares the shared C-family interfaces for type-mismatch diagnostics based on GCC’s rich-location machinery. It defines the range_label_for_type_mismatch abstraction that front ends specialize to render human-readable type labels, the helper label class that derives types from tree expressions, and the binary_op_rich_location wrapper used to present operand and operator locations for mismatched binary operations. The header is the public interface consumed by warning/error code in C-family front ends, rather than implementing general diagnostics or type checking itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface file for the c-type-mismatch pair: it declares the reusable diagnostic classes and APIs that other C-family code includes, while the sibling c-type-mismatch.cc provides their method definitions and source-location selection behavior.
